evidence.paraphrase: Sodium hypochlorite delivered to Mod B is 12.5 percent; it is received at the chemical unloading area and piped into an outdoor 6500-gallon bulk tank stored at atmospheric pressure.
evidence.time_scope: Bounded original historical narrative, not current installed state. Derived inventory text is not an original CSB quotation.

evidence.paraphrase: Operators pipe sodium hypochlorite from the bulk tank to a smaller day tank inside the Mod B building.
evidence.time_scope: Bounded original historical narrative, not current installed state. Derived inventory text is not an original CSB quotation.

evidence.paraphrase: Sodium hypochlorite is transferred from the day tank into an unnamed process vessel when needed.
evidence.time_scope: Bounded original historical narrative, not current installed state. Derived inventory text is not an original CSB quotation.

evidence.paraphrase: Thirty-percent sulfuric acid is received at the chemical unloading area in an outdoor 8500-gallon day tank.
evidence.time_scope: Bounded original historical narrative, not current installed state. Derived inventory text is not an original CSB quotation.

evidence.paraphrase: Operators transfer sulfuric acid directly from the day tank into the process; the destination equipment is unnamed.
evidence.time_scope: Bounded original historical narrative, not current installed state. Derived inventory text is not an original CSB quotation.

evidence.paraphrase: A sodium hypochlorite tank level indicator signals an alarm in the control system near tank capacity, notifying operators of high level. The transfer does not stop automatically because the system was not configured for that function.
evidence.time_scope: Bounded original historical narrative, not current installed state. Derived inventory text is not an original CSB quotation.
